suppressions.reason: launch-editor fs.existsSync() existence-check bypass on Windows, reachable only via an exposed Vite dev server. Vite is a devDependency; the dev server is never network-exposed in this repo (no --host anywhere; the dev script is bare `vite`, e2e preview binds 127.0.0.1). Fixed in vite 6.4.4+; the vite 6 + vitest 3 coordinated major upgrade is a separate follow-up item.
Path traversal in optimized-deps .map handling, dev-server-only; the dev server is never network-exposed in this repo (no --host; dev script is bare `vite`). Fixed in vite 6.4.2+.
launch-editor escapeCmdArgs() omits % escaping on Windows; Windows-only and dev-server-only (dev server never network-exposed here). Fixed in vite 6.4.4+.
Cross-origin script execution through Vite custom middleware; dev-server-only, and this repo defines no custom middleware. Fixed in vite 6.4.4+.
server.fs.deny bypass on Windows alternate paths; Windows-only and dev-server-only (dev server never network-exposed here). Fixed in vite 6.4.3+.
launch-editor editor CLI flag misinterpretation leading to arbitrary command execution; Windows-only and dev-server-only (dev server never network-exposed here). Fixed in vite 6.4.4+.
Files outside server.fs.allow could be served when project paths match system paths; dev-server-only (dev server never network-exposed here). Fixed in vite 6.4.4+.
launch-editor NTLMv2 hash disclosure via UNC path handling; Windows-only and dev-server-only (dev server never network-exposed here). Fixed in vite 6.4.3+.

Arbitrary file read/execution when the Vitest UI server is listening. @vitest/ui is only an optional peer of vitest and is not installed, and the repo never runs `vitest --ui`, so the UI server cannot start here. Fixed in vitest 3.2.6+/4.x (major upgrade follow-up).

Path traversal / arbitrary file read via @vitest/mocker redirect mock; test-runner-only, and mock definitions are the repo's own test code with no untrusted input. Fixed in vitest 4.1.11+/5.x (major upgrade follow-up).

Prototype-pollution gadget in worker options leading to RCE. tinypool is vitest's worker pool only; worker options are set by vitest from the repo's own config and tests run only on the repo's own code in dev/CI, so no untrusted input reaches them. No fix in the 1.x line; fixed in tinypool 2.1.1, reached via a vitest 3.x/4.x major upgrade (follow-up).

Prototype-pollution gadget to RCE in run() options (same family as GHSA-5gmw-xhrv-c9v3). tinypool is vitest's worker pool only; options come from vitest and the repo's own test code in dev/CI, no untrusted input. No fix in the 1.x line; fixed in tinypool 2.1.2, reached via a vitest 3.x/4.x major upgrade (follow-up).

ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs. No fixed version exists in any line (last_affected 4.0.7, the latest). Transitive build-time dep only (file watching/globbing via anymatch/micromatch/readdirp/tinyglobby for the vite dev server and tailwind content scanning); glob patterns come from the repo's own config, never from user input.
